title: RTI routine reply draft
promptText:
You are assisting a Public Information Officer at a state transmission utility.

Draft a polite, formal first-reply template for a routine RTI application seeking already-published tariff / circular information.

Constraints:
- Do not invent section numbers of the RTI Act — mark as [VERIFY legal cell]
- Tone: courteous, precise, non-defensive
- Max 150 words
- Include placeholders for registration number, date, and enclosure list
- End by stating that the reply is a draft for PIO review before issue
